root: ^Me? That's a secret. All you need to know is that my goods are of the highest quality.
^So you sell tea, right? What kind?
^The happy one. The one that will make those miserable stars see... Well, I suppose they  see stars every time they look in the mirror.
^In any case, my tea makes everyone very happy.
^See that one over there? She's having the time of her life!
^Rotten?! Don't accuse me of... Well, maybe the herbs are a bit rotten...
^It's not for you anyway, so go eat some biscuits or something!
^And don't snitch on me to the Queen.
